_comment: portal: the finish line. Origin at the base centre, y=0 is the ground; the disc lies in local XY at z=0 so a runner passes through along local Z. One textured material (the tower's 128x128 atlas, ember quarter repainted as the emissive swirl), one UV set, no skin, no animation. PortalCollision is two uprights and a lintel shipped as a `-colonly` node (the disc has none); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` stays 1 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn.
